$comment: Z-Image-Turbo batch for the realms' own rooms (2026-10-09; src/renderer/components/realmRoomArt.ts). One painted room per realm, each the place the realm is named for, at the dungeon ring's plate size and camera (wide, low, the floor open at the centre where the board sits) so the board and the HUD land on it the way they land on the ring. Render: py -3.12 scripts/card-pipeline/batch_local_zimage.py --manifest scripts/card-pipeline/realm-rooms.zimage.manifest.json --cpu-offload ; pick from tmp/zimage/realm-rooms.zimage.manifest/contact-sheet.png and copy the take to `target`. Then make it relightable the way the ring was (scripts/scene-pipeline/README.md): scene.sh <target> bg-gameplay-realm-<realm>-v1 <boxes.json> cuts a dark base and the additive light layers; save the base as bg-gameplay-realm-<realm>-v1-base.png and the light layers combined (lighter) as bg-gameplay-realm-<realm>-v1-glow.png, then yarn assets:ui-backgrounds:export-runtime-webp. The game picks a realm's room up as soon as its base is there and preloads it. Prompts describe only what is there (Turbo has no negative prompt, and the art rules ask for positive-only prompts).
